steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90; this is the required starting screen for the prepared state.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before using the prepared RFQ.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in Vendor A's portal.
Resubmit Vendor A's bid at the same price to exercise the revision flow.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the submission.
Return to the buyer's console to verify the resulting buyer-side records.
Open the RFQ Responses view for the buyer-side bid verification.
Confirm both Vendor A and Vendor B responses remain visible after the resubmission.
Open the comparison grid containing both bidding vendors.
Verify Vendor A's current RFQ price remains 100 after the same-price revision.
